description: Planted-defect manifest template for one grader-calibration artifact (see calibration.md). Instantiated at P2 from the pilot artifact; withheld from the grader during calibration; published with the calibration records. The known-good artifact's manifest has an empty plantedDefects array.

artifact.baseArtifact: pointer to the P2 pilot artifact commit/build this was derived from
artifact.derivationNotes: minimal, manifest-recorded edits applied to the base

plantedDefects.plantedEdit: file/behavior description of the edit that introduced the defect
plantedDefects.detectionThreshold: what a grader report must contain for this to count as detected: a failing result on a listed assertion ID, a failing probe in a named category, or a defect entry whose summary identifies this behavior

adjudications.notes: a planting-error ruling amends the artifact and this manifest
